<style>
.login-background {
  color-scheme: light;
  --background: 0 0% 100%;
  --foreground: 200 7% 5%;
  --card: 0 0% 100%;
  --card-foreground: 200 7% 5%;
  --popover: 0 0% 100%;
  --popover-foreground: 200 7% 5%;
  --muted: 30 5% 95%;
  --muted-foreground: 200 5% 30%;
  --accent: 30 5% 95%;
  --accent-foreground: 200 7% 5%;
  --border: 200 3% 70%;
  --input: 200 7% 5%;
  --ring: 51 100% 50%;
  font-family: Arial, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif;
  background: #ffffff;
  color: #0b0c0c;
}
.login-content {
  padding-top: 48px;
}
.login-content > div {
  max-width: 480px;
}
.login-background > div:first-of-type {
  min-height: 56px;
  border-bottom: 10px solid #1d70b8;
  background: #0b0c0c;
}
.login-background > div:first-of-type button {
  color: #ffffff;
}
.login-panel {
  border: none;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: transparent;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.login-logo-box {
  justify-content: flex-start;
  margin-bottom: 30px;
}
.signin-methods > div {
  height: auto;
  padding: 0;
  border: none;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #b1b4b6;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: transparent;
  overflow: visible;
}
.signin-methods [role='tablist'] {
  justify-content: flex-start;
  gap: 4px;
}
.signin-methods [role='tab'] {
  flex: none !important;
  margin-bottom: -1px;
  padding: 8px 14px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: #f3f2f1 !important;
  color: #1d70b8;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 400;
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 3px;
  box-shadow: none !important;
}
.signin-methods [role='tab'][data-state='active'] {
  border-color: #b1b4b6 #b1b4b6 #ffffff;
  background: #ffffff !important;
  color: #0b0c0c;
  text-decoration: none;
}
.login-form label {
  color: #0b0c0c;
  font-size: 19px;
  font-weight: 700;
}
.login-forget-password label {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 400;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']) {
  height: 44px;
  border: 2px solid #0b0c0c;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: #ffffff;
  color: #0b0c0c;
  font-size: 19px;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']):focus {
  outline: 3px solid #ffdd00;
  outline-offset: 0;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #0b0c0c;
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'] {
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  border: 2px solid #0b0c0c;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: #ffffff;
  color: #0b0c0c;
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'][data-state='checked'] {
  background: #ffffff;
  color: #0b0c0c;
}
.login-form a {
  color: #1d70b8;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 400;
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-decoration-thickness: 1px;
  text-underline-offset: 3px;
}
.login-form a:focus {
  outline: none;
  background: #ffdd00;
  color: #0b0c0c;
  box-shadow: 0 -2px #ffdd00, 0 4px #0b0c0c;
  text-decoration: none;
}
.login-form .login-button-box {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: flex-start;
}
.login-form .login-button {
  width: auto;
  height: auto;
  padding: 10px 18px 8px;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: {{accentColor}};
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 19px;
  font-weight: 400;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 0 color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 40%, #000000);
}
.login-form .login-button:hover {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 80%, #000000);
}
.login-form .login-button:focus {
  outline: 3px solid transparent;
  background: #ffdd00;
  color: #0b0c0c;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 0 #0b0c0c;
}
.login-form .login-signup-link {
  justify-content: flex-start;
  color: #0b0c0c;
  font-size: 16px;
}
#footer {
  padding: 24px 30px;
  border-top: 1px solid #b1b4b6;
  background: #f3f2f1;
  color: #505a5f;
  font-size: 14px;
  text-align: left;
}
.login-form .login-forget-password {
  width: 100%;
}
</style>
